title: Broadcast
list.description: Overlays for OBS, one broadcast per cast channel. Matches marked as casted on a channel show up on its overlays automatically.
list.noChannels: No cast channels yet. Add one to start a broadcast.
dashboard.holdHint: Keeps Next off air until you Take
dashboard.noScannerHint: No scanner is connected, so Next waits for a Take
dashboard.sides.label: Sides
dashboard.duration.label: On air for
dashboard.duration.countdown: Counted down on the scene. Without one, no countdown is shown.
dashboard.queue.autoHint: Goes on air by itself once the scene before it ends
dashboard.queue.onGameStartHint: Goes on air by itself once the scanner sees the game start, colored with the teams' ink
dashboard.queue.onGameEndHint: Goes on air by itself once the scanner sees the game end
dashboard.queue.clipMissing: Not every OBS source has this clip yet, it would show the OBS footage instead
dashboard.rehearseHint: Plays the transition on the Next preview, nothing goes on air
dashboard.noFeaturedMatch: No match is cast on this channel. Mark one as casted (or lock one for it) from the match page.
dashboard.resultsNotOnAir_one: {{count}} result not on air yet: live shows {{live}}, the set is at {{next}}. The next Take puts it on air.
dashboard.resultsNotOnAir_other: {{count}} results not on air yet: live shows {{live}}, the set is at {{next}}. The next Take puts them on air.
dashboard.bracket.explanation: What the bracket scene shows. Remaining shows only the rounds still being played.
dashboard.bracket.none: There is no double elimination bracket to show.
dashboard.clips.label: Clip
dashboard.clips.explanation: Without a clip, the scene shows the footage OBS has under the overlay.
dashboard.clips.transfer: Replay clips are sent straight to the overlays over a peer-to-peer connection.
dashboard.setup.clipsSynced: Every OBS source has every replay clip
dashboard.setup.program: In OBS create a new scene collection (Scene Collection → New) so your own setup stays untouched. Add your capture card and on top of it a Browser source with the URL below, sized 1920×1080 (Settings → Video canvas too). It switches scenes by itself when you Take.
dashboard.setup.scanner: Start the scanner from the header on this page in the browser capturing the game feed without this overlay over it (your capture card, or OBS Virtual Camera of a scene with only the capture card), which links it to this broadcast. It puts scenes set to wait for a game start or end on air as games start and end, telling the overlay the teams' ink colors before cutting to the game. Games still upload to sendou.ink as usual.
dashboard.setup.scannerLinkedElsewhere: This browser's scanner is linked to another broadcast, linking moves it here
dashboard.ink.clear: Clear, back to the theme's colors
overlay.standBy: Please stand by, we'll be right back
